base: Using the reference image, draw the SAME character with the exact same design, colors, proportions and pixel-art style, facing RIGHT. Late-90s SNK Neo Geo fighting game sprite style (Garou: Mark of the Wolves): hand-drawn pixel-art look, strong dark outlines, cel shading. Draw exactly 8 full-body frames of an animation sheet in a 4x2 grid (4 columns, 2 rows), read left to right, top row first. Every frame at the SAME scale as the reference stance and on the same ground line for its row, each frame fully inside its own cell with clear space between frames, no overlapping. Flat solid background color {bg}, no shadows on the background, no text, no numbers, no borders, no grid lines. Frames:

sheets.s1_idle_walk: 1-4: fighting stance idle animation loop with subtle breathing (shoulders and chest rise and fall slightly, 4 frames); 5-8: walking forward cycle (4 frames, alternating legs).
sheets.s2_move: 1: going down into crouch; 2: crouching idle; 3: jump takeoff (knees bent); 4: jumping upward, body stretched; 5: jump apex, legs tucked; 6: falling down, legs extending; 7: forward dash, body leaning low and fast; 8: standing guard, forearms raised to block.
sheets.s3_punch: 1: light jab anticipation; 2: light jab fully extended; 3: jab recovery; 4: heavy punch wind-up, torso twisted back; 5: heavy punch lunging forward; 6: heavy punch full extension with the whole body behind it; 7: heavy punch follow-through; 8: heavy punch recovery back to stance.
sheets.s4_kick: 1: light kick lifting knee; 2: light kick extended at mid height; 3: light kick recovery; 4: heavy roundhouse kick chambering; 5: heavy kick rising; 6: heavy kick fully extended high at head height; 7: heavy kick follow-through spin; 8: heavy kick landing back to stance.
sheets.s5_crouch_attacks: 1: crouching jab chamber; 2: crouching jab extended; 3: crouching short kick chamber; 4: crouching short kick extended low; 5: crouching uppercut start; 6: rising uppercut with arm fully raised; 7: low leg sweep start, one hand on the ground; 8: low sweep fully extended along the ground.
sheets.s6_air_hit: 1: jumping punch chamber in mid-air; 2: jumping punch extended downward-forward in mid-air; 3: jumping kick chamber in mid-air; 4: flying kick fully extended diagonally down in mid-air; 5: hit reaction, head snapped back; 6: heavy hit reaction, body bent backward in pain; 7: crouching hit reaction; 8: crouching guard, blocking low.
sheets.s7_knockdown: 1: knocked off the feet, body flying backward; 2: falling backward horizontally in the air; 3: hitting the ground on the back; 4: lying flat on the ground, knocked out; 5: getting up, on one knee; 6: rising back to feet; 7: throw, grabbing the opponent position with both hands forward (no opponent drawn); 8: throw, tossing forcefully over the shoulder.
sheets.s9_super_win: {super} 7: victory pose, triumphant; 8: victory pose, roaring or taunting.
